answer: Each identity pays weekly rent of 2 POA. Identities from the same funding cluster pay 2 POA times the cluster size, so ten pay 20 each per week, while a lone honest identity is a cheap relic of the free-entry era. Each extra fake from the same source raises rent on every identity the attacker already holds, so costs spiral: 100 linked fakes cost 20,000 POA weekly against 200 for 100 honest users. Dodging the multiplier means laundering fresh capital per source. Rent receipts and funding links are on-chain, so any verifier replays the graph like a public cipher and confirms every due was paid.
